integrity: The proof derives the barycentric reproducing kernel exactly, reduces the positivity problem to negative kernel mass, proves vertex extremality by convexity, and evaluates the remaining beta integral in closed form. The packaged checker independently replays the finite algebra and exact integral identities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the exact element-local L2-orthogonal projector onto affine functions on one simplex. It does not determine global continuous finite-element projection constants, higher-degree projectors, tensor-product cells, or positivity-preserving modifications. Multivariate polynomial-projector literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact positivity defect and max norm of the affine least-squares projector on a simplex
